records.title: Asteroids
records.setup: Place obstacles as normal except replace the station with 3 additional asteroid fields. No more than 2 asteroid fields of the same type may be used.
records.special-rule: Asteroid fields have no effect when overlapped by the second player's ships.

records.title: Independent Station
records.setup: Place obstacles as normal except for the station. Replace the debris fields with dust fields. The second player places the armed station subject to the objective's placement restrictions.
records.special-rule: The armed station does not provide its normal damage-card or hull recovery benefit. After each Command Phase, it attacks the closest first-player ship in range; if no ship is in range, it attacks eligible first-player squadrons.

records.title: Holonet Override
records.setup: Place obstacles as normal, including the station.
records.special-rule: The station does not provide its normal repair effect. Ships near the station may spend engineering points in increments of 2 to interact with it. The first player can place objective tokens on the station; the second player can remove objective tokens from it and gain victory tokens.
records.end-of-game: The first player scores for objective tokens remaining on the station. Victory tokens gained by the second player also contribute to that player's score.

records.title: Prototype Recovery
records.setup: Before deploying fleets, the second player chooses 1 additional non-unique squadron costing 8-20 points as the prototype and sets it aside. After obstacles are placed, the first player places an objective token at the center of the play area.
records.special-rule: When a ship at distance 1 of the objective token resolves a Squadron command, its owner may attempt to recover the prototype instead of activating squadrons by rolling a blue die. The second player has an easier success condition. On success, deploy the prototype at distance 1 of the token and discard the token. While attacking, the prototype's critical results add to its damage total.
records.end-of-game: If the prototype remains in the play area, its controlling player gains 1 victory token.

records.title: Volatile Cargo
records.setup: Place obstacles normally except do not place the station.
records.special-rule: The second player designates 3 objective ships or squadrons, including at least 1 ship. Objective units can mitigate damage, but destroying them can damage nearby units and award victory tokens to the first player.
records.end-of-game: The second player gains 2 victory tokens for each surviving objective ship or squadron that satisfies the objective's required position near the first player's edge.
